verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports Git Sync (project data lives in a Git repo), OpenAPI spec design, and an official CLI (inso-cli) that can run collection tests in CI/Git workflows — enabling a form of declarative, version-controlled API artifacts synced via automation. However, this is API-client/testing declarative config (collections, specs, environments), not true API-gateway infrastructure provisioning (routes, plugins, gateway policies) that 'APIOps' typically implies. Missing for 10: evidence of managing actual gateway/infrastructure resources (not just client collections) as declarative config, and CI-driven deployment of gateway state rather than just test execution.
